key_insight: The study builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compositions with visible-range band gaps and half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, radiation detection, and spintronic device design by mapping composition to electronic and magnetic properties.
method: Screened all Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites predicted stable by the tau tolerance factor
Computed spin-polarized density of states with hybrid-functional DFT for more than 2,500 compounds
Added bonding analysis with LOBSTER plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds analyzed, including 719 with visible band gaps and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: The database is computationally predicted and focused on Cs2BB'X6 compositions, so experimental validation and broader chemical coverage are still needed before deployment decisions.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
